title: VFA: Empowering Multilingual MLLMs via Vision-Free Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2608.26155v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models have advanced rapidly, yet most remain English-centric, as scaling multilingual multimodal instruction tuning is limited by the scarcity and high cost of high-quality non-English image-text supervision. Although multilingual text data is abundant, naive textual fine-tuning can disrupt vision-language alignment and induce catastrophic forgetting. We propose Vision-Free Adaptation (VFA), a framework that decouples multilingual language enhancement from visual alignment by composing complementary task vectors over a shared LLM backbone. Specifically, we fine-tune a base LLM on multilingual text data to derive a multilingual task vector, which is then merged with the vision-aligned task vector of an MLLM. Experiments on five MLLMs across six multilingual multimodal benchmarks show consistent improvements while preserving both general multimodal and text-only capabilities. translated_title: VFA：通过无视觉适配增强多语言多模态大语言模型
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型发展迅速，但大多数仍以英语为中心，因为扩展多语言多模态指令调优受限于高质量非英语图像-文本监督数据的稀缺和高成本。尽管多语言文本数据丰富，但简单的文本微调可能会破坏视觉-语言对齐并引发灾难性遗忘。我们提出了无视觉适配（VFA）框架，该框架通过在共享的LLM骨干上组合互补的任务向量，将多语言语言增强与视觉对齐解耦。具体来说，我们在多语言文本数据上微调基础LLM以得到多语言任务向量，然后将其与多模态大语言模型的视觉对齐任务向量合并。在五个多语言多模态基准上的六个多模态大语言模型实验表明，该方法在保持通用多模态和纯文本能力的同时，取得了持续改进。此外，使用不到2%的数据即可实现这些改进。
tldr: 提出了一种通过组合互补任务向量来解耦多语言增强与视觉对齐的框架，仅用不到2%的数据即可在多语言多模态基准上提升多个MLLM的性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes a framework that decouples multilingual enhancement from visual alignment by composing complementary task vectors, improving multiple MLLMs on multilingual multimodal benchmarks with less than 2% of data.
